title: Investing in the public benefit
description: Anthropic is committing 5% of its shares to a new Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, subject to stockholder approval, with an additional 2% at the board's discretion for each 50% rise in company value above a baseline. Combined with founder pledges and an employee equity match, roughly 20% of shares would be dedicated to the public good. The fund's equity will not be used for lobbying or political giving.

title: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks
description: Anthropic describes strengthened defenses against distillation, where fraudulent accounts are used to replicate a model's capabilities without authorization. The company says early evidence shows the measures cut harvested reasoning data by roughly 90 to 99%. It acknowledges trade-offs, including some developers needing to update integrations and occasional misclassification of benign requests.

title: Anthropic opens Singapore office and signs MOU with the Government of Singapore
description: Anthropic announced a new office in Singapore along with an MOU with the Government of Singapore. The post is listed in the company's newsroom on October 14, 2026.
